spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A spectator, a beholder, one of an audience.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 The eye.
2 Any public show or spectacle, a sight.
3 A place where public exhibitions are held.
nf. (-णं-णा)
Seeing, viewing, looking at, regarding.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Looking, who looks at.
f. (-का)
A woman fond of seeing shows.
E.
प्रेक्षण seeing, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Visible, apparent.
2 Looking or appearing like.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.; also with कन् added, प्रेक्षणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं).

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Looking at or on, beholding, regarding.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being seen or looked at.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Intellect, understanding.
2

Dancing.
3

Seeing, viewing, observing.
4 Seeing a play or entertainment of dancing, &c.
5 The branch of a tree.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, beheld, looked at.
E.
प्र before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Going, wandering.
2

Entering.
3

Twinging.
4

A minor drama in one act.
E.
प्र before इखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ङ्खन्-ङ्खन्ती-ङ्खत्)
1 Touching, being in contact with.
2 Scattering, diffusing.
3 Shaking, moving.
4 Wandering, roving.
E.
प्र before इखि to go, शतृ aff.

f. (-ङ्खा)
1 A swing, a sort of hammock or swinging cot, either for travelling or diversion.
2 Wandering, roaming, travelling about.
3 A horse's going or motion.
4 Dancing.
E.
प्र before इखि to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-नं)
1 Shaken, moving, set in motion, swung, &c. Joined to, being in contact with.
E.
प्र before इखि to go, aff. क्त or प्रेङ्खा a swing, इतच् aff.

n. (-नं)
A swing, a swing cot or hammock.
E.
प्रङ्खोल to swing or shake, nominal verb, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Agitated, shaken, swung, set in motion.
E.
प्रेङ्खोल nominal verb, to swing, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dead, deceased.
m. (-तः)
1 A ghost, a goblin a sprite, an evil being, especially animating the carcases of the dead.
2 The spirit before obsequial rites are performed.
E.
प्र before इत gone.

n. (-र्म्म)
Funeral or obsequial rites.
E.
प्रेत, and कम्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया, &c.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead.
E.
प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.

nf. (-त्यं-त्या)
Obsequial rites.
E.
प्रेत, and कृत्य a ceremony; also प्रेतकर्म्म, &c.

n. (-हं)
A cemetery, a burying ground.
E.
प्रेत a sprite, and गृह abode.

n. (-त्वं)
The character or state of a departed spirit.
E.
प्रेत, and त्व aff.

n. (-मं)
The smoke of a funeral pile.
E.
प्रेत, and धूम smoke.

f. (-दी)
The river of hell.
E.
प्रेत a goblin, and नदी a river.

m. (-रः)
A ghost, a corpse.
E.
प्रेत, and नर a man.

m. (-कः)
1 A man employed to carry forth dead bodies.
2 A kinsman who does so.
E.
प्रेत, निर् out, हृ to take, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-क्षं)
The dark half of the month.
E.
प्रेत, and पक्ष a fortnight.

m. (-हः)
A drum played at the death of a person.
E.
प्रेत dead, and पटह a drum.

m. (-तिः)
YAMA, ruler of the dead.
E.
प्रेत dead, and पति master.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel used in obsequial presentations.
E.
प्रेत, and पात्र a vessel.

m. (-जः)
YAMA.
E.
प्रेत, and राज king.

m. (-कः)
The region of disembodied spirits, in which they remain for one year, or until the obsequial rites are completed.
E.
प्रेत, and लोक region.

n. (-नं)
A burying ground, a cemetery, a place where bodies are burnt or buried.
E.
प्रेत a sprite, and वन a wood.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Possessed by a devil or fiend.
E.
प्रेत a sprite, and वाहित borne, actuated.

m. (-द्धिः)
Purification after the death of a kinsman.
E.
प्रेत, and शुद्धि purifying.

m. (-रः)
One who carries a corpse, a near kinsman.
E.
प्रेत, and हार who takes.

n. (-न्नं)
Food offered to the manes, or distributed on a person's death.
E.
प्रेत, and अन्न food.

m. (-शः)
An offering to the manes.
E.
प्रेत, and उद्देश object.

ind.
1 In the next world.
2 Having died.
E.
प्रेत dead, and यत् aff,; or प्र before इ to go, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Desirous of obtaining.
E.
प्र before अप to obtain, desid. v., उ aff.

mn. (-मा-म)
1 Affection, kindness, tender regard.
2 Pleasure, sport, pastime, joy.
m. (-मा)
1

INDRA.
2

Air.
E.
प्र for प्रिय loved, इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Affectionate, loving, constant.
E.
प्रेम, and पर attached to.

n. (-नं)
Rheum, tears.
E.
प्रेम tenderness, पातन falling.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Dearest, most beloved, very dear.
f. (-सी)
A wife, a mistress.
E.
प्रिय dear, and ईयसुम् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
A heron.
E.
प्रेयस् dear, and अपत्य offspring.

n. (-णं)
1 Sending, directing.
2 Ordering, commanding.
3 Passion, operation of the organs of sense.
4 The sense of the causal verb.
E.
प्र before ईर to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sent, directed, dispatched.
2 Ordered.
E.
प्र before ईर to go, aff. क्त.

m. (-वः)
Being born again after dying.
E.
प्रेत्य, भाव nature.

n. (-नं)
1 Pervading, spreading.
2 Satisfying.
E.
प्र before ईर to go, इवि to pervade, &c. ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्त्वा)
The ocean.
f. (-री)
A river.
E.
प्र before ईर to go, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्, and तुट् aug.

(ऋ) प्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (प्रेषते)
To go, to move or approach.

m. (-षः)
1 Sending, directing, dispatching.
2 Pain, affliction.
E.
प्र before इष to go or send, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
Sending, dispatching.
E.
प्र before इष to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sent, directed.
E.
प्र before इष to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्)
Sent, having sent.
E.
प्र before इष to go, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Most or very dear.
f. (-ष्ठा)
1 A wife.
2 The leg.
E.
प्रिय dear, aff. इष्ठन्, form irr.

m. (-ष्यः)
A servant.
E.
प्र before इष to go, or प्रेष to send, aff. ण्यत्; also प्रैष्य.
